{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the number of sites
unique_sites = trial_df['site'].unique()
print(unique_sites)

# Calculate response rate per site
response_rate = trial_df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print(response_rate)

# Find the site with the highest response rate
best_site = response_rate.idxmax()
best_rate = response_rate.max()

print(f'Best site: {best_site}, Response rate: {best_rate:.3f}')"}
